title: Change-Detector Tests (Over-Interaction Verification)
pattern: Tests that enforce exact calls to non-state-changing query methods of a collaborator, asserting *how* a system arrived at a result rather than *what* the result is.
why_bad: Non-state-changing interactions (queries) are private implementation details. Change-detector tests break in response to harmless refactoring (e.g., adding cache lookups, changing query order) even when the external behavior is completely preserved [209].
detection: The test uses mocking verifications (`verify()`, `times()`) on collaborator methods that perform read-only queries or returns data without mutating external state [530].
fix: Rely on state-based testing (asserting returned values or final system state) instead of interaction verification [208, 526]. Only verify state-changing interactions that are explicit requirements [529].
